description: Data engineering guidance for Dota AI Coach — sourcing match data from OpenDota/STRATZ, identifiers (Steam IDs, match IDs, patch IDs, rank tiers), hero/item reference data, match timelines and replays, API caching, and the RAW→BRONZE→NORMALIZED→FEATURES→DATASET pipeline using DuckDB/Parquet. Use whenever fetching, caching, normalizing, storing, or building a training dataset from historical Dota 2 match data, or when deciding how a new data source or dataset should be structured. Existing dataset-quality bugs (Turbo mixed into ranked training data, leakage, duplicate matches, missing patch/timestamp) are expensive to discover after a model is trained — consult this skill before data flows into a pipeline, not after.
